meta.description: Before the old year has even passed, new guests have arrived at the door.

units.rawText: At the Oasis.
units.displayText: At the Oasis.

units.rawText: Ah... Is it because you feel our workloads are too heavy?
units.displayText: Ah... Is it because you feel our workloads are too heavy?

spans.text: Ah... Is it because you feel our workloads are too heavy?

units.rawText: You do have a point. It hasn't been long since Croque recovered from her Entropic infection and she's still clearing up the work that's been accumulating in the Engineering Department.

units.rawText: Alright. I'll be counting on you then, Professor... Feel free to look for me if you need my help.

units.rawText: How about Kuro?
units.displayText: How about Kuro?

units.rawText: Hm... As for Kuro...
units.displayText: Hm... As for Kuro...

spans.text: Hm... As for Kuro...

units.displayText: In the hallway, two doors down from the room adjacent to the main hall.

spans.text: In the hallway, two doors down from the room adjacent to the main hall.

units.rawText: Hi, chat~ This is everyone's favorite streamer Kuro—
units.displayText: Hi, chat~ This is everyone's favorite streamer Kuro—

spans.text: Hi, chat~ This is everyone's favorite streamer Kuro—

units.rawText: Perhaps you've already noticed the background of the hall we're in? That's right, we're somewhere in an official reception lounge.
units.displayText: Perhaps you've already noticed the background of the hall we're in? That's right, we're somewhere in an official reception lounge.

spans.text: Perhaps you've already noticed the background of the hall we're in? That's right, we're somewhere in an official reception lounge.

units.rawText: Ehhh? What? Chat is asking "Aren't you scared of being caught for slacking off so openly?" Haha, that's what makes it fun!
units.displayText: Ehhh? What? Chat is asking "Aren't you scared of being caught for slacking off so openly?" Haha, that's what makes it fun!

spans.text: Ehhh? What? Chat is asking "Aren't you scared of being caught for slacking off so openly?" Haha, that's what makes it fun!

units.rawText: Next, I'm going to turn slacking off into skipping work. Why don't you see how long it takes for them to find out I'm gone? I'm very confident in myself!
units.displayText: Next, I'm going to turn slacking off into skipping work. Why don't you see how long it takes for them to find out I'm gone? I'm very confident in myself!

spans.text: Next, I'm going to turn slacking off into skipping work. Why don't you see how long it takes for them to find out I'm gone? I'm very confident in myself!

units.displayText: If you like it, make sure to send me a boost to cheer me on!

spans.text: If you like it, make sure to send me a boost to cheer me on!

units.displayText: Kuro looks to either side. The hallway is empty.

units.rawText: Right now, the Oasis doesn't have as many people in it as a major district of Burbank... So skipping work doesn't seem too fun.

spans.text: Right now, the Oasis doesn't have as many people in it as a major district of Burbank... So skipping work doesn't seem too fun.

units.rawText: (Sigh) If only Reverence were here, messing with her is way more fun than messing with the Oasis Dolls.

units.rawText: I've got it! Chat, our next mission is called "Uncovering the Mysteries of the Oasis Cafeteria!"
units.displayText: I've got it! Chat, our next mission is called "Uncovering the Mysteries of the Oasis Cafeteria!"

spans.text: I've got it! Chat, our next mission is called "Uncovering the Mysteries of the Oasis Cafeteria!"

units.rawText: Aren't you curious, chat? Operands are the same no matter how you eat them, but the Oasis has a cafeteria!
units.displayText: Aren't you curious, chat? Operands are the same no matter how you eat them, but the Oasis has a cafeteria!

spans.text: Aren't you curious, chat? Operands are the same no matter how you eat them, but the Oasis has a cafeteria!

units.rawText: And the strangest thing is that the Oasis' cafeteria can make food from operands that actually tastes good!
units.displayText: And the strangest thing is that the Oasis' cafeteria can make food from operands that actually tastes good!

spans.text: And the strangest thing is that the Oasis' cafeteria can make food from operands that actually tastes good!

units.rawText: There are crooked restaurants in reality who add strange things to their food to spice things up. Maybe the Oasis adds tiny quantities of viruses or something too!
units.displayText: There are crooked restaurants in reality who add strange things to their food to spice things up. Maybe the Oasis adds tiny quantities of viruses or something too!

spans.text: There are crooked restaurants in reality who add strange things to their food to spice things up. Maybe the Oasis adds tiny quantities of viruses or something too!

units.rawText: Who's that saying I'm talking nonsense? Hehe, let's go find out exactly what's going on...

units.rawText: So... What are you doing here?
units.displayText: So... What are you doing here?

spans.text: So... What are you doing here?

units.displayText: We're holding a meeting to choose an organizer for the New Year's celebration party.

spans.text: Don't tell me you came to the cafeteria simply because the tables here are round.

spans.text: I already did, it hasn't stopped yet... Say, isn't the door in this livestream kind of familiar?

units.displayText: At the Oasis, in the Doll reception lounge.

units.displayText: Oh hey, you're here, Kuro. So I wasn't supposed to be filling this shift alone?

spans.text: Oh hey, you're here, Kuro. So I wasn't supposed to be filling this shift alone?
